lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor twenty-two. A hundred and ninety megawatts — twenty more than nineteen, and that is the whole of what Actual could find you. Spend it like it cost something.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Anchor damper's cleared. Eighteen megawatts fixed, and inside its arc it kills most of what they're pulling off the bus. You are spending power to stop losing power.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: So it pays for itself when they bring enough men.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It pays for itself when they bring three. Under that you'd rather have the gun.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Captain. You brought a bigger core. I'd have brought a bigger core.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: This channel is for my people.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: It was ours first. We're only lending it back.
lines.beat: he is on Meridian's channel and does not pretend otherwise

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact on the north lane. Mixed — wardens and men.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They're walking in with the wardens.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They're walking in *behind* the wardens. It's not an alliance, it's a queue.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Damper's holding about two thirds of the tap inside its arc. Outside the arc you're paying full price.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: You're doing the sums now. Good. Every megawatt you spend keeping us off your bus is a gun you didn't build.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: You've done this before.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Nineteen times. You're the first one who's still talking at wave five.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Meridian Actual to field lead. Advise on whether Sable Reach is to be treated as hostile.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They're shooting at me, Control.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Understood. Advise if that changes.
lines.beat: command still will not say the word hostile

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Bus is over. Half of that is theirs, not ours — put a damper on the lane they're walking.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: One past. Close it up.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez, the ring's taking hits. Whatever we're saving, it isn't the ring.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Pull back. All crews, off the deck. — Captain, that's twice you've made me pay for a survey I already owned.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: He said owned.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: I heard it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Rotate your people, Captain. That's an order you'll like.
